name: In-place rounds, 782 qubits
description: Rounds in place on the eight state registers, five additions a round, with an adder that takes the word in parts of four bits and keeps the carry into each part. 782 qubits at reaction depth 1,227. K + W + Sigma1 + Ch is reduced to two rows that are never stored and added into h as two additions. It sits on the reaction-depth front between Zero scratch and Lean lookahead rounds. Built on the generator of Lean lookahead rounds.
